# Orbyss Foundation Execution Core

Defines owned operation deadlines, remaining time, expiry and independently owned stage caps.
Caller cancellation remains distinguishable from deadline expiry. The contracts depend only on the BCL.
Provider timeout settings and application outcome policy remain outside this package.
